audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Exodus / Shemot text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Sinai arrival, eagle-wing deliverance, treasured possession, priestly kingdom, holy nation, boundary/holiness, thunder-cloud theophany.

verses.restored: In third month after children of Israel went out from land of Egypt, on this day, they came to wilderness of Sinai.

familiar.text: In the third month, when the children of Israel were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.restored: They journeyed from Rephidim and came to wilderness of Sinai and camped in wilderness; Israel camped there before the mountain.

familiar.text: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Israel camped before the mount.

verses.restored: Moses went up to the Divine, and YHWH called to him from mountain, saying, Thus you shall say to house of Jacob and tell children of Israel:

familiar.text: And Moses went up unto God, and the LORD called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel;

verses.restored: You yourselves saw what I did to Egypt, and I carried you on wings of eagles and brought you to myself.

familiar.text: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles’ wings, and brought you unto myself.

verses.restored: And now, if listening you listen to my voice and keep my covenant, then you shall be my treasured possession from all peoples, for all earth is mine.

familiar.text: Now therefore, if ye will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:

verses.restored: And you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation. These are the words you shall speak to children of Israel.

familiar.text: And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel.

verses.restored: Moses came and called elders of the people and placed before them all these words that YHWH commanded him.

familiar.text: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded him.

verses.restored: All the people answered together and said, All that YHWH has spoken we will do. Moses returned words of the people to YHWH.

familiar.text: And all the people answered together, and said, All that the LORD hath spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto the LORD.

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, Look, I am coming to you in thickness of cloud, so the people may hear when I speak with you and also trust in you into the age. Moses told words of people to YHWH.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto thee in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with thee, and believe thee for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto the LORD.

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, Go to the people and sanctify them today and tomorrow; let them wash their garments.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,

verses.restored: Let them be ready for third day, for on third day YHWH will come down before eyes of all people upon Mount Sinai.

familiar.text: And be ready against the third day: for the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.

verses.restored: You shall set boundary for the people all around, saying, Guard yourselves from going up mountain or touching its edge. Everyone touching mountain shall surely be put to death.

familiar.text: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that ye go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death:

verses.restored: No hand shall touch him, but stoning he shall be stoned or shooting he shall be shot; whether beast or human, one shall not live. When ram's horn draws long, they may go up to mountain.

familiar.text: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.

verses.restored: Moses went down from mountain to people and sanctified the people, and they washed their garments.

familiar.text: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.

verses.restored: He said to the people, Be ready for third day; do not approach a woman.

familiar.text: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.

verses.restored: It happened on third day, when morning came, there were voices/thunders and flashes, heavy cloud upon mountain, and very strong voice of horn; all people in camp trembled.

familiar.text: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.

verses.restored: Moses brought the people out from camp to meet the Divine, and they stationed themselves at foot of mountain.

familiar.text: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.

verses.restored: Mount Sinai was all smoke because YHWH descended upon it in fire; its smoke went up like smoke of kiln, and whole mountain trembled greatly.

familiar.text: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because the LORD descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.

verses.restored: Voice of horn grew stronger and stronger; Moses spoke, and the Divine answered him in voice.

familiar.text: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and God answered him by a voice.

verses.restored: YHWH came down upon Mount Sinai, to top of mountain; YHWH called Moses to top of mountain, and Moses went up.

familiar.text: And the LORD came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and the LORD called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, Go down, warn the people lest they break through to YHWH to see, and many of them fall.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.

verses.restored: Also priests who come near to YHWH must sanctify themselves, lest YHWH break out upon them.

familiar.text: And let the priests also, which come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break forth upon them.

verses.restored: Moses said to YHWH, The people cannot come up to Mount Sinai, because you yourself warned us, saying, Set boundary around mountain and sanctify it.

familiar.text: And Moses said unto the LORD, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for thou chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.

verses.restored: YHWH said to him, Go, go down, and you shall come up, you and Aaron with you; but priests and people shall not break through to come up to YHWH, lest he break out upon them.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto him, Away, get thee down, and thou shalt come up, thou, and Aaron with thee: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the LORD, lest he break forth upon them.

verses.restored: Moses went down to the people and said to them.

familiar.text: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.

translation_notes: Covenant identity is grounded in prior liberation: eagle wings before obedience.
Treasured possession does not cancel the wider claim 'all earth is mine.' Election is vocation, not supremacy.
Kingdom of priests / holy nation is communal vocation toward Divine service.
Boundary language marks holiness and danger of theophany; avoid weaponizing it as exclusion beyond the narrative.
safety_note: Sinai holiness should not be used for coercive spiritual hierarchy. The chapter frames covenant as response to liberation and presence, with boundaries around overwhelming theophany.
